g1|variants|invoice correction.family_title: SAP S/4HANA Invoice Correction Request (ICR) Variants
g1|variants|invoice correction.summary: Invoice correction handles overbillings or underbillings on already posted billing documents through dedicated SD correction processes. The variants differ by whether the correction is initiated via a debit/credit memo request, an advanced return/correction order, or a localized country-specific statutory procedure.

variants.name: Standard Credit Memo Request for Overbilling
variants.when_used: Customer was overbilled on an invoice and a credit memo needs to be issued after sales approval.
variants.key_config: Sales document type CR configured for credit memo request, referencing billing document, with billing block for review.

variants.name: Standard Debit Memo Request for Underbilling
variants.when_used: Customer was underbilled due to incorrect pricing or missed charges on the original invoice.
variants.key_config: Sales document type DR configured for debit memo request, referencing original billing document to adjust pricing.

variants.name: Advanced Return Management - Correction with Replacement
variants.when_used: Handling customer complaints where physical goods return triggers an automatic correction and replacement delivery.
variants.key_config: Advanced Returns Management enabled with follow-up activity set to replacement and credit memo/correction integration.

variants.name: Poland / Hungary Statutory Invoice Correction (Korekta)
variants.when_used: Statutory requirements in specific European jurisdictions demanding formal structured correction invoice documents linked to the original tax invoice.
variants.key_config: Country-specific billing types and output determination configured to meet legal tax audit trail and structure requirements for corrections.

compare_groups.covers: Copy controls from billing to request, pricing type adjustments, and tax recalculation.

g1|core|invoice correction|standard cred.title: Standard Credit Memo Request for Overbilling
g1|core|invoice correction|standard cred.story: When a customer is accidentally charged too much money on their bill, the order-to-cash team creates a special sales document to give them a refund or credit. A Standard Credit Memo Request for Overbilling allows companies to safely correct billing errors by referencing the original invoice, getting internal approval, and then generating a credit memo to balance the customer's account. If this process is not set up correctly, the customer remains overcharged, financial audits fail, and customer satisfaction drops drastically.
g1|core|invoice correction|standard cred.why_business_needs_it: Businesses require a formal control mechanism to correct billing overcharges without directly editing finalized accounting documents. The credit memo request (CR) process ensures proper financial governance, managerial sign-off, and accurate tax adjustments before issuing a credit memo (G2) against the original billing document.

modules.role: Manages the credit memo request sales document type CR, references original billing documents, and controls pricing elements and billing blocks.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for credit memo posting and tax adjustments.

modules.role: Receives the billing document G2 generated from the credit memo request, posts the credit to the customer account, and reverses the excess revenue and taxes.
modules.hands_off_to: SD to update document flow and release billing blocks.

prerequisites: Customer Master Data with Sales Area View -- XD03 / BP
Material Master Data (Service / Non-Stock Material G2N) -- MM03
Original Billing Document with Overbilling -- VF03

config_steps.step: Check Sales Document Types for Credit Memo Request
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type: CR; Order category: H; SvQ active: checked; Dlv.rel.prof.: blank; Billing type: G2; Item init.type: G
config_steps.check: Execute SE16N on table TVAK and verify entry CR exists with order category H and billing type G2.
config_steps.why: Sales document types control the entire processing lifecycle, number assignment, and billing linkage for credit requests in Order-to-Cash.
config_steps.if_missing: If sales document type CR is missing, system error V1301 occurs during VA01 creation and prevents the credit process.
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select sales document type CR and click Details (Magnifying glass)
Verify Order category is set to H for Inquiry/Quotation/Order
Verify SvQ active checkbox is selected
Verify Dlv.rel.prof. field is blank
Set Billing type to G2
Set Item init.type to G
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Defines document as an order variant
Links credit memo request to billing type G2
Initial item category for order generation

config_steps.step: Define Item Categories for Credit Memo Request
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item Category: G2N; Item type: Standard; Billing relevance: B; Pricing: X
config_steps.check: Execute SE16N on table TVAPT for item category G2N and verify description and billing relevance.
config_steps.why: Item categories determine whether a credit line item generates billing due list entries and executes pricing procedures.
config_steps.if_missing: If item category G2N is missing, credit items fail to pull pricing and cannot be billed in VF01.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category G2N and click Details
Set Item type to Standard
Set Billing relevance to B (Relevant for billing - based on order)
Set Pricing to X (Standard)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport request

fields.note: Credit memo request item category for services
Triggers billing directly from order quantity

config_steps.step: Assign Item Categories for Credit Memo Request
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type: CR; Item Category Group: NORM; Higher Level Item: blank; Default Item Category: G2N
config_steps.check: Create a sales order using VA01 with type CR and material G2N, then verify the item category defaults to G2N.
config_steps.why: Automatic item category determination ensures that materials added to a credit request receive the correct billing and pricing controls without manual user intervention.
config_steps.if_missing: If item category assignment is missing, system message V1313 occurs when adding items in VA01.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Doc. Type as CR
Enter Item Category Group as NORM
Leave Higher Level Item blank
Enter Default Item Category as G2N
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport request

config_steps.step: Define Billing Types for Credit Memo
config_steps.where: VOFA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Define Billing Types
config_steps.values: Billing Type: G2; Sign (+/-): -; Account Determination Procedure: KOFI00; Cancellation billing type: S2
config_steps.check: Execute SE16N on table TVFK for billing type G2 and verify sign is set to minus.
config_steps.why: Billing types dictate accounting postings, debit/credit signs, and general ledger integration parameters.
config_steps.if_missing: If billing type G2 is misconfigured, credit memos post as positive amounts to customer accounts, increasing their debt instead of refunding them.
actions: Enter /nVOFA in the command field and press Enter
Select billing type G2 and click Details
Set Sign (+/-) to - (Negative posting / Credit)
Set Account Determination Procedure to KOFI00
Set Cancellation billing type to S2
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport request

fields.note: Inverts value for credit balance posting
Document type generated upon cancellation of G2

config_steps.step: Define Copy Control for Sales Document to Billing Document
config_steps.where: VTAF -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Define Billing Document Request > Copy Control: Sales Document to Billing Document
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Copy Control Sales Document to Billing Document": Details
config_steps.values: Source Sales Doc: CR; Target Billing Doc: G2; Item Category Copy Control: G2N to G2N with Copy routine 003
config_steps.check: Attempt to bill a credit memo request using VF01 and verify that billing document G2 is successfully generated.
config_steps.why: Copy control defines how header and item data migrate from the sales order document into the final billing document.
config_steps.if_missing: If copy control rules are missing, VF01 returns error message VF040 indicating no billing due list records found.
actions: Enter /nVTAF in the command field and press Enter
Select Source Sales Doc CR and Target Billing Doc G2
Navigate to Item level folder in dialog structure
Select item category G2N to G2N relationship and click Details
Verify Copy routine is set to 003 (Order-related)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport request

config_steps.step: Define Reasons for Credit Memo Requests
config_steps.where: OVX6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Order Reasons
config_steps.check: Create a sales order using VA01 and verify that order reason 001 is selectable in the header data.
config_steps.why: Order reasons categorize sales document creation causes for auditing, financial reporting, and root-cause analysis.
config_steps.if_missing: If order reason 001 is missing, users cannot classify why the credit memo request is being raised.
actions: Enter /nOVX6 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Order Reason as 001
Enter Description as Overbilling correction
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign to transport request

fields.note: Business explanation for credit memo request

config_steps.step: Identify overbilled invoice and note billing document number
config_steps.where: VF03 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Document > Display
config_steps.check: Verify that document displays correct payer, material, and inflated price elements.
config_steps.why: Verifying the original billing document ensures the credit memo request correctly references the source of the overcharge.
config_steps.if_missing: If the wrong invoice is referenced, incorrect financial postings occur and audit trails break.
actions: Enter /nVF03 in the command field and press Enter
Enter the Billing Document number of the overbilled transaction
Press Enter to open the billing document overview
Review pricing elements and net value to confirm overbilling error
Note down the Billing Document number for reference in the credit memo request

config_steps.step: Create Credit Memo Request referencing original invoice
config_steps.where: VA01 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Order > Create
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type: CR; Reference Document: Billing Doc 90000000; Order Reason: 001
config_steps.check: Execute VA03 for the newly created credit memo request and verify items and pricing match the referenced invoice.
config_steps.why: Creating a credit memo request referencing the original invoice establishes the necessary document flow and audit trail for the refund.
config_steps.if_missing: If reference creation fails, system error V1558 occurs, preventing proper tracing between invoice and credit.
actions: Enter /nVA01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Order Type as CR
Click Create with Reference button on the application toolbar
Select Billing Doc tab in the pop-up window
Enter the original Billing Document number in the Billing Document field
Click Copy button to transfer items
Enter Order Reason 001 (Overbilling correction) in the header details
Save (Ctrl+S) and record the generated Credit Memo Request number

run_steps.result: Identifies incorrect pricing or quantities billed to the customer.

run_steps.result: Creates credit memo request document CR linked via document flow to the original invoice.

run_steps.step: Release billing block on credit memo request (if automatic block is configured)
run_steps.result: Removes the billing block, enabling downstream billing creation.

run_steps.step: Create Credit Memo from Credit Memo Request

run_steps.result: Posts credit entry to financial accounting, reducing customer receivables.

errors.title: Billing Type Missing in Sales Document Type Configuration
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- creating the credit memo request
errors.message_text: Billing type G2 is not defined for sales document type CR
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot figure out which invoice document to create because the link between the sales order type and the billing type is broken.
errors.cause: The assignment of billing type G2 to sales document type CR is missing in Customizing table TVCPF or transaction VOFM / SPRO.
errors.config_step: Assign Billing Types to Sales Document Types
errors.verify: Re-run VA01 for sales document type CR, save, and attempt to create billing document in VF01 to confirm no error occurs.
errors.prevent: Ensure all standard sales document types are copied completely from delivery-related or order-related template profiles during client transport initialization.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal Billing Configuration Guide

fix_steps.step: Navigate to Customizing path for Sales and Distribution billing assignment.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Define Billing Types
fix_steps.values: Check assignment of billing type G2 to sales document type CR

fix_steps.step: Access transaction code VOR1 or maintain assignment view via SPRO.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Header -> Define Sales Document Types
fix_steps.values: Set Billing Type field to G2 for Sales Document Type CR

errors.title: Item Category G2N Not Allowed for Sales Document Type CR
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- entering item data in credit memo request
errors.message_text: Item category G2N is not allowed for sales document type CR
errors.plain_meaning: The sales order doesn't recognize the specific line item type you are trying to use for the correction.
errors.cause: Item category determination for sales document type CR and item category group NORM (or relevant material group) lacks entry for item category G2N in table TVEP or VOV4.
errors.verify: Create a new sales document in VA01 with sales document type CR and verify that item category G2N defaults automatically.
errors.prevent: Always verify item category determination matrix entries across all sales area combinations when introducing new correction document types.
errors.ref_title: SAP Community Discussion on Item Category Determination

fix_steps.step: Open Customizing table maintenance for item category determination.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Item -> Assign Item Categories
fix_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: CR, Item Category Group: NORM, Default Item Category: G2N

errors.title: Reference Mandatory Error for Credit Memo Request without Original Invoice
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- saving the credit memo request
errors.message_text: Reference mandatory for sales document type CR
errors.plain_meaning: You cannot create a credit memo request out of thin air; you must tie it back to the original billing document.
errors.cause: Sales document type CR is configured with reference mandatory indicator set in table TVAK, but no preceding billing document was referenced during creation in VA01.
errors.verify: Create credit memo request using VA01 referencing an existing billing document and check that it saves without reference errors.
errors.prevent: Train OTC order processors to always use 'Create with Reference' when initiating overbilling credit memo requests.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal Sales Document Configuration

fix_steps.step: Maintain sales document type control settings.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Header -> Define Sales Document Types
fix_steps.values: Check 'Reference mandatory' field settings for document type CR

fix_steps.step: Create credit memo request using reference transaction.
fix_steps.values: Click 'Create with Reference', enter original billing document number in Billing Doc tab

errors.title: Pricing Procedure Determination Missing for Credit Memo Request
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- checking condition analysis in credit memo request
errors.message_text: Pricing procedure could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot calculate the refund amount because it lacks the pricing sheet rules for this credit memo.
errors.cause: Pricing procedure determination (table T683V) is missing the combination of sales area, document pricing procedure (from sales document type CR), and customer pricing procedure.
errors.verify: Open the credit memo request in VA02, go to Item Conditions tab, and verify that pricing procedure populates correctly with active condition types.
errors.prevent: Include pricing procedure determination checks in all client copy transport verification checklists.

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Basic Functions -> Pricing -> Pricing Control -> Define Pricing Procedure Determination
fix_steps.values: Sales Area, Doc Pricing Procedure (e.g. from CR), Cust Pricing Procedure -> Pricing Procedure

errors.title: Billing Block Active on Credit Memo Request
errors.where_seen: VF01 -- attempting to bill credit memo request
errors.plain_meaning: You are trying to issue a refund invoice, but a safety lock is holding it back until a manager reviews it.
errors.cause: Sales document type CR or credit memo request header is configured with a default billing block reason (e.g., credit check or pricing review block).
errors.config_step: Define Sales Document Types / Assign Billing Block Reasons
errors.verify: Re-run billing creation in VF01 for the credit memo request and confirm the billing document generates successfully.
errors.prevent: Ensure business users understand the credit memo approval workflow requirements before attempting downstream billing execution.

fix_steps.step: Access sales document change transaction to remove billing block.
fix_steps.values: Header Details -> Billing Document tab -> Clear Billing Block field

fix_steps.step: Review sales document type default settings.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Header -> Define Sales Document Types
fix_steps.values: Check 'Billing block' field default for document type CR

errors.title: Copy Control Missing from Credit Memo Request to Billing Document G2
errors.where_seen: VF01 -- creating billing document G2 from credit memo request
errors.message_text: No billing document generated. See log
errors.plain_meaning: The pipeline carrying data from your credit memo request to the final refund invoice is disconnected.
errors.cause: Copy control settings between sales document type CR and billing type G2 are missing at the header or item level in transaction VTFA.
errors.config_step: Maintain Copy Control for Sales Document to Billing Document
errors.verify: Execute VF01 referencing the credit memo request and verify that billing document type G2 is successfully created without error logs.
errors.prevent: Always verify VTFA copy control rules when deploying custom sales document types or billing types.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal Copy Control Reference

fix_steps.step: Maintain copy control rules from sales order to billing document.
fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Billing -> Billing Documents -> Maintain Copy Control for Sales Documents -> Copy Control: Sales Document to Billing Document
fix_steps.values: Source: CR, Target: G2, Header routine: 001, Item routine: 002 (G2N)
